summary: The phone's Home reads each attention item's presentation (Now group, card, held step) instead of deriving it from the item's kind

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites; no contract change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes; no coordinated member upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: Upgrade daemons before clients. The phone reads Attention.presentation (presentation capability, version 1). A registered custom kind now shows on Home as the Today request st presents; before, the phone dropped it. An item without a presentation (an older daemon, or one st has not presented yet), or with a group or card the phone does not know, shows as unplaced under somebody is stopped on you when st marks it an alert and when there is time otherwise, saying why; the phone offers only the answers st lists for it, and a message or fault stays off Home.

downtime.detail: No startup work or expected interruption.

manual.detail: No operator actions, client re-pairing or configuration changes required.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or swap-back restrictions.
